name: query_bindingdb
description: Get drug-protein binding affinities (Ki, IC50) from BindingDB for a target protein (requires data lake volume mounted)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.data_lake import query_bindingdb; result = query_bindingdb('EGFR', top_k=20)

parameters.top_k: int — number of top binding compounds to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: target, compounds (list of {ligand_name, smiles, ki_nm, ic50_nm}), source
